outer_diameter_state: BOUND 24.95-26.34 mm, and if it moves it moves DOWN. The drawn value is NOT a settled diameter and NOT an independent opinion on the OD.
fabrication_delta: L4 measured 0.30 mm is below PCBWay's 0.40 mm four-layer floor and JLCPCB's 0.40 mm minimum. The Replica AS DRAWN cannot be ordered at either house. That is a fact about US, not about Apple. The two numbers are never fused.
surface_finish: gold-bearing — ENIG or another immersion/electroless-gold finish

pocket.walls_note: A facet's arc ends where the boundary crosses 0.30 mm from the superellipse, NOT where the wall is. The wall POSITIONS ARE NOT MEASURED (board.json).
pocket.no_diameter_published: This lane publishes NO centre-hole diameter. Three superellipse fits disagree on the exponent and in different directions (board.json).

netlist_binding:
CANNOT DETERMINE — the netlist is READ (65 nets from lane
L11) and NOT ONE PAD ON THIS BOARD CAN BE ATTACHED TO IT, because the two
sides name different objects. The schematic's nodes are IDENTIFIED PARTS
(U1, U3, C1..C5, X1, X2). This board's placements are METROLOGY ROWS -- the
producing lane's own words for its handoff are "A LIST OF METAL AND BLUE. It
is NOT a list of components." There is no row-to-refdes map anywhere in this
repo and building one by eye is the contamination this whole lane exists to
prevent.

ONE row IS identified: handoff D000 is the nRF52832, M08's positive control.
It still cannot bind, for a second and independent reason -- L11 drew U1 with
KiCad's QFN-48 symbol because no WLCSP-50 ball map is sourced, so the sheet's
pin NUMBERS are a different package's. Binding by number would attach signals
to the wrong balls; binding by name needs the ball map that does not exist.

SO THE COPPER ON THIS BOARD HAS NO CONNECTIVITY, and that is stated rather
than repaired. What would close it: a published nRF52832-CIAA ball map, and
a row-to-refdes assignment produced by measurement rather than by eye.

orientation.source: components-front.json angle_deg and dark-packages-front.json angle_deg, keyed on the measured position
orientation.applied_to: CLASS B rows only — a min-area-rect angle from an untrustworthy rect is untrustworthy too (board.json)
orientation.what_it_is_not: the long side modulo 180 deg. It does not say which end is pin 1 and on a square body it says nothing.

soc.identification: M08's POSITIVE CONTROL. Blue-epoxy colour (B-R = +43 vs a board median of +1); measured 3.283 x 3.030 mm against the datasheet body 3.226 x 2.956 mm.
soc.copper: NONE. The land pattern is REFUSED, not drawn. Body and grid geometry are on F.Fab only.
soc.why_refused: The part is a WLCSP-50; a 0.40 mm grid inside the measured body is 8x7 = 56 positions and no ball map in this repo or in KiCad's 179 Package_CSP footprints says which 6 are depopulated. Six lands that do not exist on the part are six lands a fabricator would make.
soc.raised_by: lane L11, 2026-09-05 - 'the board would build, DRC would pass, and the picture would look right'
cannot_determine: which 6 of the 56 grid positions are depopulated
where ball A1 is — the angle is a long side modulo 180 deg
the ~2 % between the colour-segmented body and the datasheet body (M08 raises this itself)
